headline: Three ORT sessions coexist in EVERY context where ORT runs. All 18 inferences per cell element-exact, 0 mismatches of 262,144.
All sessions SHARE ONE WebAssembly.Memory (two on Firefox, same 16 MB total). Sessions 2 and 3 added ZERO bytes.
Teardown does not shrink the heap - that is spec-correct, NOT a leak.
Repeated create/infer/destroy cycles produced NO WASM heap growth: flat at 16 MB across 15 further lifecycles per cell, both backends, both platforms.
JS heap is INCONCLUSIVE and reported UNKNOWN: it rose 12.4->24.7 MB in one cell and FELL 25.9->10.8 MB in a single step in another. GC-timing dominated.
WebGPU shares the same WASM heap - the JSEP backend does not allocate a second one. GPU-side memory is not visible to this instrumentation.
S-03b: multi-threaded WASM (numThreads=4) is FEASIBLE on Chrome where SharedArrayBuffer exists. Feasibility only - no performance claim.
NOT CLEARED: 16 MB is almost certainly ORT's initial arena and three trivial sessions never forced a grow(). The dossier's ~120 MB resident-model risk is untouched.
not_established: heap exhaustion (no grow() was ever forced)
